recent_commits.message: feat: Implement pagination and role filtering in user metrics page
Add ExportButton component and integrate it into reports and metrics pages

request.text: Add a CSV export button to the dashboard that lets a user download the currently filtered list of records as a CSV file.

open_questions.default: Create the table and its filter state fresh in src/features/workflow/components/documents-table/DocumentsTable.tsx, the only existing documents-table directory in the pack.
open_questions.q: Where does the real documents dashboard table actually live, and what shape is its filter state, given that neither src/features/documents/components/DocumentsTable.tsx nor any documents-list table file is visible in the pack?

open_questions.default: Implement exportDocumentsToCsv.ts as a self-contained next-safe-action action that accepts filter params and queries records directly, to be reconciled with the real data layer during implementation.
open_questions.q: What server action/data-access pattern should the export action reuse to fetch filtered document records, given no existing documents query logic is visible in the pack?

tasks.description: Create src/features/workflow/components/documents-table/exportDocumentsToCsv.ts implementing a next-safe-action action that accepts filter parameters (status, source, search, date range, etc.), fetches matching document records, serializes them into CSV text (header row + one line per record, comma-escaped), base64-encodes the CSV string, and returns { data: { file: base64String, filename: 'documents-export-<timestamp>.csv' } } to match the ExportButton's expected response shape.
tasks.done_criteria: Calling the action with a filter object returns a base64 payload and filename ending in .csv containing only rows matching those filters
tasks.title: Add server action to export filtered documents as CSV

tasks.description: Create src/features/workflow/components/documents-table/DocumentsTable.tsx that renders the documents list with filter state (status/source/search), and imports ExportButton from src/components/shared/ExportButton.tsx to render it near the table's toolbar, passing action={exportDocumentsToCsv}, params set from the table's live filter state, and label='Export to CSV'.
tasks.done_criteria: The export button appears above/beside the documents table and its params prop reflects the table's live filter state on each render
tasks.title: Create DocumentsTable with filters and CSV ExportButton wired in

tasks.description: Add src/features/workflow/components/documents-table/exportDocumentsToCsv.test.ts covering: (1) unit test that given filter params, the action produces correctly-escaped CSV rows and returns { data: { file, filename } } matching ExportButton's expected shape (base64 string, filename ending .csv); (2) integration test against seeded/mocked document records verifying the returned CSV body contains exactly the rows matching a given filter and a proper header row.
tasks.done_criteria: New tests fail without t1's implementation and pass with it, covering CSV content correctness, filter pass-through, and the response shape ExportButton depends on
tasks.title: Unit and integration test the CSV export action and response shape

assumptions.text: No documents-list table component currently exists at any path visible in the pack (the previously-claimed src/features/documents/components/DocumentsTable.tsx does not exist), so a new DocumentsTable.tsx must be created inside the existing src/features/workflow/components/documents-table/ directory, which already holds a sibling documents-table file (RelatedDocsExpandedRow.tsx) and is therefore the correct home for this table and its filter state

The project uses next-safe-action server actions (as shown by useAction in ExportButton.tsx), so the new CSV export logic must be implemented as a next-safe-action action following the same pattern (returning { data: { file: base64string, filename: string } })

A new server action file exportDocumentsToCsv.ts is needed since no existing CSV export action for documents is visible in the pack; it will query documents via whatever data-access pattern the new DocumentsTable.tsx uses to populate its own rows
CSV generation will use a simple in-house serializer (join fields with commas, escape quotes) rather than adding a new dependency, since no CSV library is visible in the pack

criteria.given: the documents table is rendered with one or more filters applied (e.g. status or source filter set in its filter state)
criteria.then: a new server action is invoked with the current filter parameters and returns a base64-encoded CSV file plus a filename ending in .csv
criteria.when: the user clicks the new CSV export button

criteria.given: a server action response containing a base64 CSV payload and a filename like documents-export.csv
criteria.then: the action's returned data shape matches { data: { file: base64String, filename: string } } so ExportButton produces a text/csv Blob and triggers a download with that filename
criteria.when: the export action's result is processed by the reused ExportButton component

criteria.given: the export server action is called with filter parameters matching a subset of seeded document records
criteria.then: the returned CSV content contains only rows matching those filters, with a header row and one line per matching record
criteria.when: the action executes against the data layer

non_goals: Will not modify src/components/shared/ExportButton.tsx because it already supports CSV via filename-extension MIME detection and base64 blob handling; it needs no code change, only a new action passed into it
Will not modify src/proxy.ts because the export action will call existing documents data-fetching logic directly rather than altering the shared proxy layer

Will not modify src/features/workflow/components/documents-table/RelatedDocsExpandedRow.tsx because it is an expanded-row detail panel, not the table or its filter state, and is unaffected by adding an export action
spec.problem_statement: The documents dashboard table has no way to export its currently filtered rows as a CSV file. The reusable src/components/shared/ExportButton.tsx already supports CSV downloads via base64-encoded server action responses (it picks the .csv MIME type when filename ends in .csv), but no CSV-generating server action exists yet and no table component in the repo renders an ExportButton wired to filter state. Since the exact documents-table component path referenced in prior feedback does not exist in this repo, this plan places the new CSV export action and its wiring in src/features/workflow/components/documents-table/ (the only documents-table directory visible in the pack, containing RelatedDocsExpandedRow.tsx), alongside a new documents table component and its tests. Done means a visible export button on that table triggers a CSV download containing only the rows matching the table's active filters.
